stories.title: Coca-Cola launches Zero Zero variant in India with Zepto
stories.summary: Coca-Cola has introduced Coca-Cola Zero Zero, a zero-sugar and zero-caffeine variant, in India. The product is available on quick-commerce platform Zepto in select cities, with a pan-India rollout planned. The company says the launch is for all the Coca-Cola lovers. Caffeine is now optional.

stories.title: JioStar builds buzz for Sri Lanka series with a playful T20 promo
stories.summary: JioStar has released a promo for the upcoming India-Sri Lanka T20I series featuring cricketers Tilak Varma, Abhishek Sharma and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. The campaign uses a hotel setting to highlight the players' roles. The series is scheduled to take place from December 22 to 27.

stories.title: CSB Bank puts children at the centre of its
stories.summary: CSB Bank has launched its first brand campaign, Banking Ki Boli, featuring children explaining financial terminology. The digital films have garnered nearly seven million views in one week. The bank says brand building is about connecting with people rather than being seen everywhere.

stories.title: Milky Mist’s Capella and PivotRoots bring a new narrative to dark chocolate advertising
stories.summary: Milky Mist’s Capella has launched a campaign titled Sincere Indulgence to redefine dark chocolate. The brand film draws parallels between the creative process of an artist and the traditional production of cacao. Capella aims to position dark chocolate beyond its conventional identity as a less-sweet alternative.

stories.title: Licious puts choosy meat buyers at the centre of new campaign
stories.summary: Licious has launched a campaign titled Choosy Logon Ki Choice, highlighting consumer preferences for meat and seafood. The films feature the company's 0 to 4°C cold chain and 30-minute delivery service. The company states that in a personal category like meat, choice is a product differentiator.

stories.title: Sachin Tendulkar calls out unhealthy habits in Sugarfit
stories.summary: Sugarfit has released a campaign featuring Sachin Tendulkar to address lifestyle habits affecting metabolic health. Titled #SugarfitMeany, the film shows the ambassador discouraging late-night snacking and sedentary routines. The campaign encourages people to rethink their daily habits to improve their metabolic health.

stories.title: Woodnote Whisky announces Amaya as the setting for Woodnote Escapades
stories.summary: Woodnote Whisky will host ten participants at Amaya, a mountain retreat near Kasauli, for a three-day getaway in January 2027. The retreat, designed by architect Bijoy Jain, features stone and wood structures. The event is centred on nature, seasonal dining and shared discovery.

stories.title: Platinum Love Bands
stories.summary: Platinum Guild International India has launched a campaign for Platinum Love Bands, directed by Shoojit Sircar. The film follows a couple in an arranged marriage preparing for their future home. The gesture of labelling cupboards is presented as a turning point in their relationship.

stories.title: Puneet Das resigns as Britannia Industries
stories.summary: Puneet Das has resigned as chief marketing officer of Britannia Industries after ten months at the company. He joined in February 2026 to lead the marketing function. Das previously spent six years at Tata Consumer Products, where he held various leadership roles across the beverages portfolio.

stories.title: WPP Media’s new-business value stands at $207 million for Jan-Sept 2026
stories.summary: WPP Media recorded $207 million in new-business value between January and September 2026, according to COMvergence. Wavemaker led the agency rankings with $145 million. The report analyzed 131 account pitches in India, where local pitches accounted for 82 percent of the total activity.

stories.title: Dolly Tayal steps down as Managing Director of Burson Genesis India
stories.summary: Dolly Tayal has stepped down as Managing Director of Burson Genesis India after two years. She has over two decades of experience in communications, primarily within the WPP and Burson ecosystem. Tayal stated she does not currently have a plan for her next chapter.

stories.title: Dentsu ranks fifth in global media new business, posts $464 million net billing loss
stories.summary: Dentsu recorded a net billing loss of $464 million in the first nine months of 2026, ranking fifth in global new business results. The group reported $1.14 billion in wins against $2.652 billion in losses. Advertisers are increasingly assigning mandates at the group level.

stories.title: Havas Media Network ranks fourth in global new business, reports $149 million net billing loss
stories.summary: Havas Media Network reported a net billing loss of $149 million for the first nine months of 2026. The group recorded $773 million in new business wins against $977 million in losses. The industry is seeing a shift as holding groups secure mandates directly.

stories.title: Omnicom Media posts $4.79 billion net new business
stories.summary: Omnicom Media recorded $4.79 billion in net new business during the first nine months of 2026. The network's performance included $5.17 billion in wins and $3.72 billion in retained accounts. Group-level wins accounted for 32 percent of its acquisitions during the period.

stories.title: WPP Media ranks third in global new business wins at $1.72 billion
stories.summary: WPP Media recorded $1.72 billion in net new billings for the first nine months of 2026. The group saw $3.76 billion in wins, but also recorded $4.22 billion in lost billings, the highest volume among the five largest media groups. Wins included Jaguar Land Rover and Estée Lauder.

stories.title: Publicis Media records $7.18 billion in new business value
stories.summary: Publicis Media generated $7.18 billion in total new business value during the first nine months of 2026, according to COMvergence. The group recorded $6.19 billion in net new business after accounting for wins and losses. It currently leads the major global media agency groups.

stories.title: Ogilvy wins global agency of record mandate for Veet
stories.summary: Ogilvy has been appointed global agency of record for Reckitt-owned brand Veet following a competitive pitch. The mandate covers advertising, social media and influencer campaigns, with Ogilvy UK leading the account. The brand appointed the agency directly to develop a global campaign platform.

stories.title: Indian comedian Samay Raina becomes first YouTube creator to cross 1 million channel members
stories.summary: Comedian Samay Raina is the first YouTube creator to reach one million paid channel members. YouTube reported that over 1.2 million fans in India purchased memberships in June 2026, contributing to a 25 percent year-over-year revenue growth for Indian creators. Community interaction is credited for the milestone.

stories.title: YouTube creator networks scale into media companies
stories.summary: SimpleGhar, a network of tech and gadget review channels, has grown from a single bedroom camera in 2022 to a 35-person media company. The network now produces content in seven languages, illustrating the shift from hobbyist unboxing videos to structured corporate payrolls. The bedroom is now likely an office.

stories.title: YouTube expands custom Shorts thumbnails to all creators
stories.summary: YouTube has made custom thumbnails available to all Shorts creators, completing a rollout that began with Partner Program members in July. Creators can now upload images during the upload process or change them after publishing. If they prefer not to choose, the platform will suggest a frame.

stories.title: House subcommittee schedules hearing on creator economy
stories.summary: The House Committee on Small Business will hold a hearing titled Beyond the Content: Small Businesses in America’s Creator Economy on December 1. The session will take place in the Rayburn House Office Building. The committee notice does not list any witnesses or legislation for consideration.

stories.title: NextWave Media founder discusses creator business models
stories.summary: Hudson Matter, founder of NextWave Media, suggests that new SBA guidance for creators will likely change little for full-time professionals, though it may influence brand deal rates. He argues that a creator business must be built to outlive its founder to be considered a true enterprise.

stories.title: Platform view counts vary by payment and engagement
stories.summary: One million views on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube do not result in identical paychecks. YouTube views often reflect intentional searches, while Instagram and Facebook counts frequently include brief autoplay sessions. Advertisers pay based on these differing definitions of engagement, which remain subject to platform policy and seasonality.

stories.title: Samay Raina reaches 1 million YouTube channel members
stories.summary: Comedian Samay Raina has become the first creator globally to surpass 1 million YouTube channel members. His content, ranging from chess livestreams to talent shows, has accumulated 1.53 billion views across 969 videos. Google India confirmed the milestone, noting a growing trend of audience financial support for creators.

stories.title: Samay Raina's million-member moment: Is YouTube membership the next creator goldmine? - Moneycontrol.com
Women creators expand reach in finance and science
stories.summary: A growing number of women creators are using short videos and storytelling to explain complex topics like index funds and research papers. These educators aim to make finance, science and farming accessible to audiences who previously found such subjects too technical or intimidating to follow.

stories.title: YouTube Shopping launches in Australia with Amazon
stories.summary: YouTube has launched its Shopping affiliate program in Australia, featuring Amazon.com.au as its exclusive retail partner. Eligible creators can now tag products in long-form videos, Shorts and livestreams. The integration allows viewers to move from a video recommendation directly to a retailer purchase via YouTube Studio.

stories.title: SYS010 malware targets Meta business accounts
stories.summary: Fake Facebook ads for animated wallpapers are distributing the SYS010 information stealer. The malware forces browsers to install extensions that harvest session cookies and advertising data. Once a business account is compromised, attackers can use the trusted identity to fund further malicious advertisements.

stories.title: Senacon orders Google and Meta to expand information on paid advertisements - iGaming Brazil
X head of safety advocates for verifiable content decisions
stories.summary: X head of safety Michael O’Herlihy says the platform is building visibility into safety decisions and allowing authors to appeal them. He suggests that detailed written rules reduce ambiguity in content moderation. The company aims to move beyond the question of human versus machine to focus on transparency.

stories.title: Meta Ad Library requires careful filtering for accurate counts
stories.summary: Meta Ad Library may group multiple ad versions under a single result card, potentially inflating perceived ad counts. Users are advised to select specific Pages and check for grouped versions before reporting on competitor activity. One search result does not necessarily equate to one individual ad.

stories.title: Thai SEC and Meta coordinate on investment advertising
stories.summary: The Thai SEC and Meta are tightening oversight of investment-related advertisements to mitigate scams. Hubbis reports that the initiative focuses on data processing and verification practices. The collaboration aims to address the prevalence of fraudulent financial content appearing on the platform through stricter advertiser checks.

stories.title: Meta integrates Muse AI into Instagram shopping
stories.summary: Meta is prompting users in the U.S. and Canada to use its AI assistant, Muse, to organize saved posts. The company plans to charge merchant fees on purchases completed through the assistant. An executive stated that easier access to saved products is intended to increase advertiser conversion rates.

stories.title: Amazon and Meta discuss AI shopping agent access
stories.summary: Amazon and Meta are reportedly in negotiations regarding the potential return of Meta’s Muse AI agent to the Amazon marketplace. The discussions involve product search visibility and advertising formats. Both companies have declined to comment, and no agreement or launch date has been established.

stories.title: Meta removes placement control for advertisers
stories.summary: Meta is removing the Placements option from ad sets, preventing advertisers from selectively excluding specific locations across the platform. Advertisers will no longer be able to opt out of showing ads in search results or between Reels. The feature is being phased out across the ecosystem.

stories.title: Brands urged to use data for Thanksgiving marketing
stories.summary: Retailers are being encouraged to move beyond generic discount emails for Thanksgiving campaigns. Experts suggest that using customer data to time offers more effectively can drive engagement. Many brands currently rely on mass promotional scheduling, assuming all shoppers share the same motivations for making a purchase.

stories.title: Chile's Stilo raises $765K to take its AI influencer platform to Mexico - Dealroom
MarTech trends for 2027 focus on agentic AI and consolidation
stories.summary: Marketing technology is expected to focus on enhancing customer experiences and achieving measurable business outcomes by 2027. Budgets are projected at 7.8 percent of company revenue, according to Gartner. Trends include the integration of agentic AI in campaign execution and the emergence of AI search as a discipline.

stories.title: Netcore introduces agentic marketing platform updates
stories.summary: Netcore has announced new agentic capabilities and an outcome-based pricing model. The platform features an AI super agent named Zeno, an autonomous decisioning engine, and a content agent designed to build personalized content for customer interactions. The company says these tools are geared towards driving specific business outcomes.

stories.title: Media industry leaders discuss growth and AI
Martech stacks struggle to distinguish humans from machines
stories.summary: Marketing technology has long operated on the assumption that website visitors are human. Analytics platforms and attribution models are designed to record human behavior, but a growing share of traffic now comes from machines. Most current martech stacks are not designed to tell the difference between the two.

stories.title: OtterlyAI launches ChatGPT plugin for search analytics
stories.summary: OtterlyAI has launched a ChatGPT plugin that allows marketing teams to query their search visibility data in plain language. The platform, which claims to be used by more than 40,000 professionals, is also expanding its tracking to include Bing AI Mode, DeepSeek, Meta Muse, Naver AI and Grok.

stories.title: AI personas and the impact on digital creators
stories.summary: A McGill University report identified nearly 300 social media accounts using hijacked creator identities to spread disinformation. McKinsey projects AI could disrupt 36 million U.S. jobs by 2035, with Hispanic workers overrepresented in exposed sectors. Instagram now requires mandatory disclosure for synthetic personas to maintain algorithmic reach.

stories.title: Zeely offers AI-driven advertising for small businesses
stories.summary: Zeely is an AI advertising platform that helps users generate image and video ads for Facebook and Instagram. The service allows businesses to import product details and use AI avatars or scripts to create content. The company offers tiered subscriptions based on credit allowances for campaign management.
